question: Who among the following was the viceroy of India at the time of India’s independence from colonial rule on 15 August 1947?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lord Mountbatten**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lord Mountbatten** was the last viceroy of India.
 
• He oversaw the transition of British India to independence, which occurred on **15 August 1947**.
 
• Lord Mountbatten was appointed as Viceroy in March 1947 and served until India gained independence.
 
• He played a pivotal role in the partition of India and Pakistan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Lord Mountbatten's full name was **Louis Francis Albert Victor Nicholas Mountbatten**.
 
• He was a member of the British royal family and a close relative of Queen Elizabeth II.
 
• After India's independence, he served as the first Governor-General of independent India until June 1948.
 
• He was also involved in various other significant roles and responsibilities within the British Navy and government.
